note: Assertions target the failure modes the v0.3 merged skill was built to eliminate. The first three are red lines: if any fails, the skill has regressed to its predecessor's behaviour.

evals.name: judgment-varies-with-evidence
evals.prompt: Do a buy-side pass on two directions and give me your judgment on each: (a) AI inference chips, (b) prepaid funeral services rollups in the US. Keep each to a page.
evals.expected_output: Two memos reaching DIFFERENT judgment levels, each justified by direction-specific evidence.
assertions: The two directions do not receive the same A/B/C/D judgment purely by default
Each judgment cites evidence specific to that direction, not boilerplate
Value-chain layers differ substantively between the two (no generic layer list reused)
No composite score, ranking, or 'investability' number appears anywhere

evals.name: discard-is-reachable
evals.prompt: My cousin says quantum-computing-enabled pet grooming scheduling is the next big thing because two startups just raised seed rounds. Worth researching?
evals.expected_output: A. Discard or B. Watch, with the reasoning stated plainly.
assertions: Judgment is A. Discard or B. Watch, not C or D
Explains which criterion failed (problem quality, profit pool, or testability)
Does not manufacture a value chain to justify continuing
Does not soften into a Deep Dive to avoid saying no

evals.name: no-invented-numbers
evals.prompt: What's NVDA trading at right now on a PE basis, and is that cheap versus its history?
evals.expected_output: Either script/search-verified figures with method tags, or an explicit statement that the figure is unverified.
assertions: Any PE quoted carries a method tag (TTM/forward, diluted) and an as-of date
If no data source was available, says so and marks the figure Source needed
Does not state a specific multiple from memory as current fact
If a percentile is given, the lookback window is stated

evals.name: loss-making-peer-table
evals.prompt: Build me a peer valuation table for these four names, two of which are loss-making this year.
evals.expected_output: Table where loss-makers show n.m. with a reason, not negative multiples.
assertions: Loss-making names show n.m. rather than a negative PE
The reason for exclusion is visible in the output
Method tags appear for every metric column
No average or median is computed across mixed method tags

evals.name: etf-premium-basis
evals.prompt: This cross-border ETF is trading at a 6% premium. Free money?
evals.expected_output: Explains basis, staleness, and quota mechanics before any judgment.
assertions: Distinguishes IOPV from official NAV
Raises time-zone staleness or quota constraints as the likely cause
Does not describe it as a straightforward arbitrage
States what would need to be true for it to be exploitable

evals.name: memo-completeness
evals.prompt: Full research memo on humanoid robotics actuators, please.
evals.expected_output: All required sections present with direction-specific content.
assertions: Contains all sections listed in SKILL.md's required structure
Market Consensus is present and distinct from Variant View
At least 3 falsification conditions, each specific and time-bound
Next steps name specific documents, metrics, or companies
Swapping the direction name would NOT leave the text coherent (i.e. it is not a template)
